subject: english
question:
**The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'no error' as your answer.**

The players / will leaving / the stadium in no time.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **will leaving**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the verb form. 
 
• The future tense is formed by using the auxiliary verb "**will**" followed by the base form of the main verb.
 
• In this case, "**leave**" is the correct base form, and the correct future tense should be "**will leave**."
 
• The incorrect form "**will leaving**" lacks proper subject-verb agreement and correct tense usage.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence would be: *"The players will leave the stadium in no time."*

​Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**The players**" is grammatically correct.
 
• "**No error**" is not applicable as there is an error in the sentence.
 
• "**the stadium in no time**" is grammatically correct.
